name: sgs/form-step
title: SGS Form Step
description: Groups form fields into a step for multi-step forms.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: CONTENT-kind composite (WS-4 composite-mirror, render.php:104-117) — width/spacing layer only via SGS_Container_Wrapper('content'). block.json declares no `margin` spacing support (only padding) and no typography support, so those members are honest gaps. Layer CONTENT names the structural role (naming discipline, FR-35-1) — this block has no GRID layer. textColourGradient is the text-colour gradient sibling to textColour, same background-clip:text mechanism as sgs/counter's labelColour/labelColourGradient (D636 gap-closure). textColourHover/textColourHoverGradient added 2026-09-07 (colour-conformance bg-layer batch) — this element ALSO carries css:background-color (backgroundColour, painted via sgs_fill_states_css on the same $sgs_fs_sel selector, render.php), so a hover text-gradient's background-clip:text would clip/overwrite the background; render.php only swaps the background onto its own ::after layer for the specific instance where the resolved hover text value is actually a gradient (conditional-swap pattern, mirrors the brand-strip itemTextColourHover fix c785a3b7a).

textColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of textColourHover. Non-empty wins over textColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
